summary: PIMCO Asset-Based Lending Co LLC filed an 8-K reporting the dissolution of its Series I series, triggered by a Certificate of Cancellation filed in Delaware on June 15, 2026. The filing describes the Third Amended and Restated Operating Agreement and updated indemnification agreements to reflect Series I's liquidation, wind-up, and dissolution. No specific financial terms, premium, or advisor are disclosed. The dissolution reduces the company's legal structure to Series II only. Watch for any residual liabilities or regulatory filing related to final distribution to Series I members; risk-arb angle is limited as this is an internal entity restructure.
